title: Daily Workout · October 23
note: 55-minute workout. Use HOKA Clifton 9 rather than New Balance 1080v15 due to reported right-foot tingling with the New Balance. Flat treadmill. Stop if tingling returns. Keep Plow Pose gentle without loading the neck, and stop core work if groin or back pain occurs.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side and gently draw your upper heel toward your glutes. Switch sides after 30 seconds.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit tall with soles of feet together; allow knees to relax outward without forcing them down.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Sit tall and rotate gently within a comfortable range; switch sides halfway.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.instructions: Enter and exit gently. Avoid pressure on the neck and do not force the feet toward the floor.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Start at a comfortable pace in HOKA Clifton 9 shoes.

items.name: Steady walk
items.instructions: Maintain a natural stride and conversational effort. Stop if foot tingling returns.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Walk briskly, without jogging, adjusting speed for comfort.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Ease down gradually to a comfortable pace.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Lie with knees bent, lower elbows under control, and press weights upward without arching your back or holding your breath.

items.name: Supported one-arm dumbbell row
items.detail: 4 minutes · 2 sets of 10 reps per side
items.instructions: Brace one hand on a stable support, maintain a neutral back, and pull the dumbbell toward your hip.

items.name: Lateral raises
items.instructions: Raise dumbbells toward shoulder height with soft elbows and without shrugging.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.instructions: Keep a neutral spine and breathe normally. Stop if groin or back discomfort develops. After this hold, rest for 60 seconds before starting set 2.

items.name: Forearm plank
items.instructions: Begin after your 60-second rest. Keep a neutral spine and breathe normally. Stop if groin or back discomfort develops.

items.name: Cloud hands
items.instructions: Take slow side steps while hands sweep smoothly across the body.

items.name: Parting the horse's mane
items.instructions: Step gently forward while separating the arms in a flowing motion.

items.name: Brush knee and push
items.instructions: Brush one hand past the knee while the other pushes gently forward; alternate sides.

items.name: Side steps with arm swings
items.instructions: Step side to side and swing arms gently in a relaxed rhythm.
